messages:
Alicia: Quick heads-up — scheduling a night maintenance window tonight 02:00-04:00 UTC for a gentle node rotation. Thermal probes on a subset of racks showed intermittent surges; we're doing a staggered soft-evict + reboot for racks 12-15 (cohort A).

Jamal: What's the exact flow? cordon -> drain -> reboot -> uncordon? Any special backfill rules? :thinking_face:

Alicia: Yep. Plan: cordon (soft), drain batch of non-priority tasks only, reboot, wait 10m for metrics, uncordon. We'll keep priority tenants pinned. Backfill comes from us-west burst pool for ~30m to avoid queueing.

Priya: Can we pre-seed KV caches on the backfill nodes? cold cache will spike tail latency if we just flood. Suggest prewarm with a light KV prime run ~20m before traffic switches.

Marco: How many nodes will be rotated at once? We should cap to keep per-pool GPU capacity >= 85% of baseline.

Alicia: 2 racks at a time (approx 8 GPUs), 15m between cohorts. Expect ~8-12% capacity blip per region. We'll not touch any dedicated/reserved pools.

Ryan-oncall: I can add temporary slo-fallbacks and bump retry windows. Also will forward a quick support note for customer-facing teams. Please put rollback criteria in the thread.

Jamal: Rollback criteria request: if 95th latency > baseline+120ms for >10m OR error rate >0.5%, abort and failover backfill -> cancel reboots and uncordon early.

Priya: Adding to ops checklist: run `infractl prewarm --target=backfill-us-west --pattern=kv-read:50/s` 20m before. Also run healthcheck after uncordon: `infractl smoke --rack=$RACK --gpu --slo-check`.

Alicia: Good. I'll add those commands to the runbook. I'll also tag the routing policy to prefer regional replicas during the window.

sre-bot: Scheduled window created: night-rotation-6175000000 (02:00-04:00 UTC). Notifications sent to @oncall and @support.

Marco: Cost note — using burst backfill for 30m will add ~0.6% monthly spend for the region. Ops OK with this; we should attribute to thermal mitigation budget.

Ryan-oncall: I'll watch the dashboard and post a short update at +30m and at window end. If anything looks odd we'll halt and roll back.

Alicia: Perfect. Final checklist in order: 1) Prewarm KV, 2) Cordon cohort A, 3) Drain non-priority tasks, 4) Reboot nodes, 5) Wait 10m + smoke checks, 6) Uncordon, 7) Post-window metric check and notify.

Jamal: A couple quick asks: annotate the events in infra history with the cohort IDs and include affected tenant tag list. Helps downstream cost/incident attribution.

Alicia: Will do. I'll post the runbook link here 15m before start and update the infra history tags after each cohort. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
